item.title: No injuries reported in 5-vehicle crash in Brownsville
item.description: BROWNSVILLE, Texas (ValleyCentral) — Emergency crews are responding to a five-vehicle crash that is stalling traffic near Dana Avenue and FM 802, according to a spokesperson with the Brownsville Police Department. Police say two vehicles received major damage, but no injuries were reported. Crews are directing traffic at this time.
